idea-plugin.name: Manuscript Disclosure Lint
idea-plugin.description:
16 rules that catch the statements a journal desk-rejects you for — in your .tex or .md, before you submit

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Manuscript Disclosure Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 16 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/manuscript-disclosure-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/manuscript-disclosure-lint

action.text: Manuscript Disclosure Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Manuscript Disclosure Lint on the file in the editor
